version.description: The manifest format. This build reads version 1.

services.description: Services and their paths (shape only here; detection is IDX-20).

baseline.description:
The baseline file of known rule violations, relative to the manifest; else
`cartograph.baseline.json` beside it.

contracts.description:
OpenAPI and Swagger files by glob (XS-08), besides the ones named `openapi.*` or
`swagger.*`.

clients.description:
Callers outside the workspace (XS-20): each is shown as a consumer, with an override chip,
of the entrypoints whose operations it lists.

retrieval.description: What Ask and the editor's agent can search (FE-13, board S06 under G7: no embeddings).

default_environment.description: The environment the map shows when none is asked for; else `prod`, else the first (XS-09).

environments.description: Named environments (XS-09): which files give their values, and values set by hand.

adapters.description:
Folders of subprocess adapters (XS-24), relative to this file and inside it. Naming one
runs nothing: each needs `cartograph adapters allow <name>` on every machine.

coverage.description: What the Coverage view aims for (XS-14).

file.description: The .code-workspace file this was resolved from, relative to the manifest.

path.description: The repo's top level, relative to the manifest; `../` is allowed (C5).

default_branch.description: The indexed branch; overrides the rest of the C3 ladder.

scopes.description: Only these folders, relative to the repo, produce nodes and links. Empty is the whole repo.

exclude.description: Globs left out of the index, from `files.exclude`.

max_file_bytes.description: Files larger than this are not parsed.

path.description: A folder in the repo; the whole repo when absent.

name.description: Names the rule in the baseline and in output: 1 to 100 characters, unique.

link.description: The link kinds the rule covers; any when empty.

reason.description: Why, shown with a violation: data only, at most 500 characters.

oneOf.description: No cycle among the services `from` selects, over links of `link` kinds.

Selector.description: Which nodes an end of a rule means. Every field given must hold.

tags.description:
Tags the service has all of: its `tags` in this file, plus `owner:<owner>` for each owner
of one of its files (CODEOWNERS).

path.description:
A regex (unanchored) over a file's repo path, or a table's name. On `from`, groups may be
captured; on `to`, `$1` to `$9` stand for what they captured.

LinkKind.description: A link kind of the index.

MinConfidence.description: The lowest level a link may have and still be a violation. A guessed link never is one.

path.description: A glob relative to each repo's root: `docs/api/*.yaml`. It picks among YAML and JSON files.

service.description: The service that owns the specs it matches; absent, the service whose root holds each file.

Client.description: A caller the index can't see (XS-20): a mobile app, a partner's integration.

service.description: The service that serves the calls; absent, any service that has the operation.

include.description: The kinds searched; absent means all but commit messages.

secret_scan.description: Leave anything that looks like a key or password out of search and prompts. On when absent.

ChunkKind.description: The kinds of text search indexes for Ask and MCP.

oneOf.description: Node cards: name, path, summary and main links.

sources.description:
Globs over the files that give this environment its values, as the index sees paths
(`deploy/prod/**`). They win over the environment a file's name implies.

set.description:
Values set by hand, key to value: what "Save values" writes. Only a URL, `host[:port]` or
a short identifier is kept; anything else is ignored.

targets.description:
A target in percent for each of `files`, `imports`, `calls`, `handlers`, `routes` and
`consumers`; the defaults are 98, 99, 85, none, 80 and 75.
